svg.title: Fixed 100 ms tick versus Zero-Tick
svg.desc: Top: a loop that ticks every 100 ms. Events that arrive between ticks wait for the next tick, up to 100 ms, and ticks with nothing to do still run: 12 idle ticks out of 16. Bottom: Zero-Tick handles each event the moment it arrives and does nothing in between: no idle work, no added delay.
